title: core: isCloudManaged() — one accessor for OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1 beside isHostKernelComposition, with the production fuse (no bound control plane ⇒ refuse to start)
body:
Engine half, item 1, of the coordinating card #25083 (`domain:services`, p1), filed on the hand-off from `domain:services` seat 1 (comment 6349658918 on this lane's seat post #20966). The binding text is ruling 6341690661 on #25083, **Q2 → D**; this card quotes it rather than restating it.
- **Who acts:** `domain:engine`.
- **Blocks:** #25083's services half (plugin-auth), which cannot start its build until this lands.
- **Dedupe:** none found (`git grep isCloudManaged origin/main` is empty).

Part of #25083.

## What the ruling binds (quoted)
> `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` is the managed-mode switch on EVERY boot, read by one accessor `isCloudManaged()` in `@objectstack/core` beside `isHostKernelComposition` (`core/src/stack-auth.ts`); every judgement site on the server (plugin-auth's sign-in surfaces, the admin user doors, the audience posture, invitations, the JIT path) calls it and nothing else, and every kernel in the process reads the same fact

> a production boot (not `--dev`, not `NODE_ENV=test`) that finds the variable set with no bound control plane (`OS_CLOUD_API_KEY` / `controlPlaneApiKey`, the `platformManaged` input cloud-connection already computes) refuses to start loudly at the accessor's first read / kernel boot — ⛔ not in `serve.ts`

The names are the maintainer's (`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED`, no `_ENABLED` suffix — the recorded exception to Prime Directive 9; `isCloudManaged()`, not `isManaged()`).

## Wanted
- `export function isCloudManaged(): boolean` in `packages/core/src/stack-auth.ts` (exported from `@objectstack/core`), synchronous, the one reader of `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED`.
- The fuse at the accessor's first read or at kernel boot, never in `serve.ts`: production (not `--dev`, not `NODE_ENV=test`) + variable set + no bound control plane ⇒ a loud refusal naming the variable and the missing binding. Where "bound control plane" is read must be the same fact cloud-connection's `platformManaged` already computes (one source, no second derivation).
- If the answer is memoized, export a reset for tests and name it in the PR body (the services half's tests set the variable under vitest and remove it afterwards).

## Acceptance (pin 9 as the ruling reads it)
- A `--dev` boot with the variable runs managed.
- A production boot with the variable and a bound control plane runs managed.
- A production boot with the variable and no control plane refuses loudly.
- Without the variable nothing is managed.
- `Clause-②` / `Metadata-protocol` declared per AGENTS.md (a new public export of `@objectstack/core`).
